subtitle: A prince between empire and a fading throne

panels.shot: epic low-angle wide of Tikendrajit before Kangla's gate, British troops distant on the horizon
panels.action: Tikendrajit Singh stands in royal Meitei armour at the ancient Kangla gate, hand resting on a spear, storm clouds gathering as distant British columns approach across the Imphal plain.

dialogue.text: In 1891, as empire pushed up the eastern hills, Prince Tikendrajit of Manipur chose defiance—and a kingdom on the edge learned what the loss of sovereignty truly meant.

i18n.hi: १८९१ में, जब साम्राज्य पू पूर्वी पहाड़ियों तक बढ़ा, मणिपुर के राजकुमार तिकेन्द्रजीत ने बगावत चुनी—और सरहद पर खड़े एक राज्य ने असली आज़ादी खोने का दर्द समझा।

panels.shot: bird's-eye view over Manipur valley, Kangla fort and surrounding hills
panels.action: A sweeping view of the lush Manipur valley with the moated Kangla fort at its heart, smoke from village hearths rising under a soft morning haze, Tikendrajit seen small on Kangla's rampart looking over the land.

dialogue.text: For a century, Manipur walked a narrow path—its kings still crowned at Kangla, its armies still marching, yet bound by treaty as a princely state under British protection.

i18n.hi: सौ बरस तक मणिपुर पतली डगर पर चला—कंगला में ताजपोशी, सेना भी अपनी, पर संधि के बंधन में, ब्रिटिश 'सुरक्षा' वाला रियासती राज्य।

panels.shot: medium close-up of Tikendrajit in court, half-lit, eyes sharp
panels.action: Inside the royal court, Tikendrajit sits slightly behind the throne in fine court dress, his face lean and alert, fingers drumming the armrest as older courtiers debate in the background.

dialogue.text: Prince Tikendrajit, the Senapati, rose in this half-independent kingdom—a soldier-prince watching British Residents advise, overrule and report on his king.

i18n.hi: सेनापति राजकुमार तिकेन्द्रजीत इसी आधे आज़ाद राज्य में उभरे—एक सैनिक-राजकुमार, जो देखता रहा कैसे ब्रिटिश रेज़िडेंट राजा को समझाते, काटते, ऊपर रिपोर्ट भेजते हैं।

panels.shot: dramatic interior wide of palace at night with torches, tense faces
panels.action: A torchlit palace corridor in 1890, guards shifting nervously as Tikendrajit moves with intent, shadows long against carved wooden walls, a sense of conspiracy thick in the air.

dialogue.text: In 1890, palace tensions broke. Tikendrajit led a coup that unseated one ruler and placed Kulachandra, his brother, on the throne—an internal struggle that quickly drew the Resident’s gaze.

i18n.hi: १८९० में महल का सुलगा तनाव फूट पड़ा। तिकेन्द्रजीत ने तख़्ता पलट किया, एक राजा हटाया, भाई कुलचन्द्र को गद्दी पर बैठाया—अंदरूनी जंग, जिसने तुरंत रेज़िडेंट की नज़र खींच ली।

panels.shot: two-shot across a low table hinting at unseen British Resident, Tikendrajit composed
panels.action: Tikendrajit sits opposite an unseen British official across a low table, his posture straight and calm, while outside the window soldiers drill in the courtyard.

dialogue.text: To the British, this was disorder in a protected state. They demanded Tikendrajit’s removal, citing treaty obligations. To Tikendrajit, it was Manipur’s right to decide its own kingmaker.

i18n.hi: अंग्रेजों के लिए ये 'सुरक्षित' राज्य में अराजकता थी। उन्होंने संधि दिखाकर तिकेन्द्रजीत की बर्ख़ास्ती मांगी। तिकेन्द्रजीत के लिए ये मणिपुर का अपना हक़ था—कौन बनेगा असली किंगमेकर।

panels.shot: close-up of a British document on a desk, hand tapping the seal
panels.action: A British hand with a signet ring rests on a paper bearing an official seal, other papers marked 'Manipur' and maps of the frontier scattered across the desk.

dialogue.text: The treaties in Aitchison’s collection spoke of allegiance and protection, of external affairs controlled by the British. They were silent on palace coups and who truly ruled inside Kangla’s walls.

i18n.hi: ऐचिसन की संधियों में वफ़ादारी और संरक्षण लिखे थे, बाहर की राजनीति अंग्रेजों के हाथ। पर कंगला के भीतर तख़्तापलट, और असली राज किसका—इस पर सब चुप।

panels.shot: evening wide of Imphal Residency, Meitei troops faintly visible in shadows
panels.action: The Imphal Residency bungalow stands in the fading light, its verandah quiet, while Meitei soldiers with spears and modern rifles gather in the shadows of trees beyond the compound.

dialogue.text: In March 1891, Chief Commissioner James Quinton came from Assam with troops, resolved to arrest Tikendrajit at Kangla and 'restore order'—a phrase that meant different things in Shillong and in Imphal.

i18n.hi: मार्च १८९१ में असम से चीफ़ कमिश्नर जेम्स क्विन्टन फ़ौज लेकर आया, ठानकर कि कंगला में तिकेन्द्रजीत को पकड़कर 'क़ायदा बहाल' करेगा—एक जुमला, जिसका मतलब शिलांग और इम्फ़ाल में अलग था।

panels.shot: dynamic courtyard wide at Kangla, British detachment confronting Meitei guards, Tikendrajit above
panels.action: In Kangla’s inner courtyard, a small British detachment stands tense before a line of Meitei guards; above them on a balcony, Tikendrajit looks down, face unreadable, hand on the railing.

dialogue.text: The attempt to seize him in the palace failed. The Meitei court refused to hand over their Senapati. Words gave way to a standoff, and then to something none of them had fully planned.

i18n.hi: महल के अंदर उसे पकड़ने की कोशिश नाकाम रही। मैतेई दरबार ने अपने सेनापति को सौंपने से इंकार किया। बात से बात भिड़ी, टकराव बना, फिर वो हुआ जिसकी किसी ने आख़िर तक योजना भी न बनाई थी।

panels.shot: night-time wide of Residency under siege, fires in distance, silhouettes of attackers
panels.action: Under a dark sky, the Residency compound is ringed by Meitei troops firing from behind low walls; inside, British officers huddle with sepoys, the flicker of lanterns casting sharp shadows.

dialogue.text: Soon the Residency at Imphal was besieged. British accounts speak of volleys in the dark and mounting fear; Meitei memories recall a rightful move against interference in their court.

i18n.hi: जल्द ही इम्फ़ाल का रेज़िडेंसी घिर गया। ब्रिटिश बयान अंधेरे में गोलियों की बौछार और चढ़ते डर की बात करते हैं; मैतेई यादों में ये उनके दरबार में बाहरी दख़ल के ख़िलाफ़ सही जवाब था।

panels.shot: tense interior of Residency, British officer at window, unseen attackers outside
panels.action: Inside the Residency drawing room, a British officer peers through shattered shutters while another writes hastily at a desk, a revolver laid beside the inkwell.

dialogue.text: In the chaos, five British officers died, including Political Agent Frank Grimwood. The Manipur Blue Book would later recount the night in clipped official prose, line after line of loss.

i18n.hi: अफ़रा-तफ़री में पाँच ब्रिटिश अफ़सर मारे गए, जिनमें पॉलिटिकल एजेंट फ़्रैंक ग्रिमवुड भी था। बाद में 'मणिपुर ब्लू बुक' ने उस रात को सूखी सरकारी भाषा में लिखा—हर पंक्ति में एक नया नुक़सान।

panels.shot: shadowy courtyard at Kangla, silhouetted figures, Tikendrajit turned away
panels.action: Within Kangla at night, a small group of bound British officers is led across a courtyard; Tikendrajit stands at a distance, his face turned half-away, torches burning against the dark.

dialogue.text: Quinton, Skene and others were executed under Manipur authority after negotiations broke down. To the British, it was rebellion stained with outrage; to many Meitei, it was justice in war.

i18n.hi: बातचीत टूटते ही क्विन्टन, स्कीन और कई औरों को मणिपुर के हुक्म से फाँसी दी गई। अंग्रेजों की नज़र में ये बग़ावत और 'बर्बरता' थी; कई मैतेई के लिए ये जंग का न्याय।

panels.shot: strategic map table in Kangla, Tikendrajit leaning over, officers around him
panels.action: By lamplight in a Kangla hall, Tikendrajit leans over a map of the valley, Meitei officers around him, marking routes towards the eastern hills and the main road from Cachar.

dialogue.text: There was no turning back. British India called it the 'Manipur rebellion'; Meitei leaders saw themselves defending an old kingdom against a power that now sent columns from multiple fronts.

i18n.hi: अब वापसी नहीं थी। ब्रिटिश भारत ने इसे 'मणिपुर विद्रोह' कहा; मैतेई नेताओं ने खुद को उस पुराने राज्य के रखवाले देखा, जिसे अब कई दिशाओं से आती फ़ौजों ने घेर लिया था।

panels.shot: wide valley shot of Meitei forces marching, British columns glinting far off
panels.action: Across the green valley, Meitei forces with mixed arms move along a dirt road, banners fluttering, while far on another ridge, a British column advances in tight formation, bayonets catching the light.

dialogue.text: Columns marched from Cachar and Kohima, with artillery and seasoned troops. Manipur’s soldiers fought skirmishes along the approaches, but the weight of empire pressed steadily inward toward Kangla.

i18n.hi: कछार और कोहिमा से कॉलम चले, तोपें और मंज़े हुए सिपाही साथ। मणिपुर की सेना ने रास्तों पर झड़पें लड़ीं, पर साम्राज्य का बोझ धीरे-धीरे कंगला की तरफ़ धकेलता रहा।

panels.shot: epic wide of British entry into Kangla on 27 April, Tikendrajit absent, ruins and smoke
panels.action: On 27 April 1891, British troops march through the gate of Kangla, their lines stretching back, as smoke rises from nearby structures and Meitei defenders slip away into alleys and fields.

dialogue.text: On 27 April, the punitive expedition entered Kangla. The royal citadel fell without a final pitched battle; the kingdom’s ancient capital now lay under British guns.

i18n.hi: २७ अप्रैल को दंडात्मक दस्ता कंगला में घुसा। शाही क़िला बिना आख़िरी बड़ी जंग के गिरा; सदियों पुरानी राजधानी अब ब्रिटिश तोपों के साए में थी।

panels.shot: tight shot of Tikendrajit moving through jungle path, fugitive yet composed
panels.action: Tikendrajit moves along a narrow jungle path with a small escort, his clothes travel-stained yet his head held high, shafts of light cutting through the foliage.

dialogue.text: Tikendrajit slipped from the captured capital into the hills. For a brief time he was a prince without a palace, still hoping the land itself could shield its Senapati.

i18n.hi: तिकेन्द्रजीत कब्ज़ा हुई राजधानी से फिसलकर पहाड़ों में पहुँचे। कुछ वक़्त तक वो महल-बिना राजकुमार रहे, उम्मीद बस इतनी कि यह धरती अपने सेनापति को अब भी ढक लेगी।

panels.shot: somber interior of improvised courtroom, Tikendrajit standing before British officers
panels.action: In a stark hall converted into a court, Tikendrajit stands unshackled before a table of British officers, their uniforms stiff amid the plain wooden benches.

dialogue.text: He was captured and tried by a British court convened in Manipur. The charge was waging war against the Queen and responsibility for the deaths at the Residency.

i18n.hi: उन्हें पकड़कर मणिपुर में ही बैठी ब्रिटिश अदालत में चलाया गया। इलज़ाम था महारानी के ख़िलाफ़ जंग छेड़ने और रेज़िडेंसी में हुई हत्याओं का।

panels.shot: medium close-up of Tikendrajit in court, steady gaze, light from side
panels.action: A close view shows Tikendrajit in simple attire, hands clasped before him, eyes steady, a shaft of light falling across his face in the otherwise dim hall.

dialogue.speaker: tikendrajit_singh
dialogue.text: I stood for my king and my land. Judge that as you will.

i18n.hi: "मैंने अपने राजा और अपनी धरती के लिए खड़ा हुआ। बाक़ी तुम्हारा फ़ैसला।"

panels.shot: wide of Pheida-pung polo ground with gallows erected, gathered crowd in traditional dress
panels.action: At the Pheida-pung polo ground, a stark wooden gallows rises against the sky, a large crowd of Meitei men and women in traditional dress gathered in tense silence.

dialogue.text: On 13 August 1891, Tikendrajit and Thangal General were hanged in public at the Pheida-pung ground. British officers noted the crowd’s silence; Meitei memory kept the day’s weight.

i18n.hi: १३ अगस्त १८९१ को तिकेन्द्रजीत और थंगल जनरल को फेइदा-पुंग मैदान में सबके सामने फाँसी दी गई। ब्रिटिश अफ़सरों ने भीड़ की ख़ामोशी नोट की; मैतेई यादों ने उस दिन का बोझ सँभाल लिया।

panels.shot: medium shot from behind Tikendrajit facing the crowd and distant hills at the gallows
panels.action: From behind, Tikendrajit stands on the platform, looking out over the gathered people and beyond them to the faint line of hills that ring the valley.

dialogue.text: To the British files, he remained a rebel prince lawfully punished. In Meitei remembrance, he became 'Yuvraj Tikendrajit', a martyr of a last stand for a kingdom that could no longer decide its own fate.

i18n.hi: ब्रिटिश काग़ज़ों में वो आख़िर तक क़ानूनी तौर पर सज़ाया हुआ 'बाग़ी राजकुमार' ही रहा। मैतेई यादों में वो 'युवराज तिकेन्द्रजीत' बना—आख़िरी लड़ाई का वो शहीद, जिस राज्य के हाथ अब अपनी किस्मत भी नहीं रही थी।

panels.shot: contemporary wide of Kangla ruins and restored structures, quiet and green
panels.action: In the present day, the restored ruins and white structures of Kangla sit peaceful amid trees, the moat still waters reflecting the sky, with no figures in view.

dialogue.text: Today, the treaties and the Blue Book still lie in archives, but at Kangla the earth remembers a prince who tested the line between protectorate and independence and paid with his life, so others might measure that line more clearly.

i18n.hi: आज संधियाँ और ब्लू बुक भले ही रिकॉर्ड रूमों में बंद हैं, पर कंगला की मिट्टी एक ऐसे राजकुमार को याद रखती है, जिसने सरहद तो परतंत्रता और आज़ादी के बीच तक खींचकर देखी—और जान देकर दूसरों के लिए वो लकीर साफ़ कर गया।

subtitle_i18n.en: A prince between empire and a fading throne
subtitle_i18n.hi: साम्राज्य और ढहती गद्दी के बीच एक राजकुमार
